binary_representation.description: How binary data is represented in the database. Possible values: 'Base64' (default), 'Uuid'.

connection_type.description: Possible values:`Directly`, `PrivateLink`. `Directly` is the default value

database.title: Authentication Database
database.description: Authentication database for the source. Usually 'admin'.

hosts.description: A list of host addresses for Azure Cosmos DB for Mongo DB.

packed_mode_tables.description: List of tables to be synced in packed mode; format:`<db>.<table>`(case-sensitive).

packing_mode.description: Indicates the desired sync pack mode. Accepted values are `UsePackedModeOnly` and `UseUnpackedModeOnly`. `SelectTablesForPackedMode` is deprecated.

password.description: Password used for source database authentication.

tunnel_host.description: SSH host, specify only to connect via an SSH tunnel (do not use a load balancer).

tunnel_port.description: SSH port, specify only to connect via an SSH tunnel.

tunnel_user.description: SSH user, specify only to connect via an SSH tunnel.

schema_prefix.title: Destination schema prefix
schema_prefix.description: Destination schema prefix. Prefix for each replicated schema. For example with prefix 'x', source schemas 'foo' and 'bar' get replicated as 'x_foo' and 'x_bar'. The prefix is permanent and cannot be changed after connection creation
